events.body:
Clicking the "Write a post" button on the blog homepage currently redirects to an incorrect path ([https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/BLT-Blog](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/BLT-Blog)), resulting in a "Path not found" error.

This issue will be resolved by updating the URL in scripts/build.mjs to point directly to [https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/blt-blog/posts](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/blt-blog/posts).
![Screenshot 2026-11-07 155832.png](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
